source.text:
OpenAI试图先抢跑Anthropic上市，：据报道，要赶在对手IPO前融资300亿美元，估值超过1.4万亿美元。

潜在投资者包括软银和MGX。OpenAI据称目前年化收入约500亿美元，目标年底达到700亿美元。按1.4万亿美元估值算，相当于当前年化收入的28倍；即使兑现年底目标，也还有20倍。

Anthropic预计11月IPO，一旦公开财务、接受市场定价，投资者就多了一把衡量AI公司的尺子。OpenAI选择在这之前融资，既能先争取机构预算，也有机会先给自己的估值定个锚。

Crwv的事情之前，OpenAi好像没这么着急，现在大家都发现钱不好借了，开始比谁先跑吗？
source.author: alanchen

quote_target.text:
OPENAI SEEKS $1.4 TRILLION VALUATION AHEAD OF ANTHROPIC IPO

OpenAI is reportedly racing to raise $30 billion at a valuation exceeding $1.4 trillion before Anthropic’s expected November IPO.

SoftBank and MGX are among potential investors.

OpenAI reportedly claims $50 billion in annualized revenue, targeting $70 billion by year-end.
quote_target.author: DeItaone

final_text:
At $1.4T, OpenAI would be valued at 28× its reported $50B revenue run rate, or 20× its $70B year-end target. Even hitting that target leaves a lot of future growth priced in.

Reuters says the two labs are courting similar investors. Getting funded before Anthropic’s expected IPO could help OpenAI lock in their budgets and set a valuation before public markets supply a benchmark.
media_reason: Neither supplied post nor its relevant quoted post contains images or video. Text-only native Quote selected.

research.findings: Reuters reports roughly $30B raise at over $1.4T valuation, before expected mid-November Anthropic IPO; OpenAI investor pitch claims $50B annualized revenue and targets $70B year-end; overlapping investor bases. OpenAI and SoftBank declined comment; Anthropic and MGX did not immediately respond.
Official historical baseline: $122B committed capital and $852B post-money valuation. This does not confirm the new proposed round.

factual_boundaries: Current financing terms and revenue run rates are sourced reporting, not a closed financing or independently audited figures.
Run-rate multiples use $1.4T as a hypothetical baseline: 1400/50=28 and 1400/70=20. These are not trailing annual-revenue multiples or P/E.
Year-end $70B is a target annualized run rate, not realized full-year revenue.
Strategic effect on budgets and valuation is qualified analysis, not proof of motive.
No direct revenue multiple comparison between companies: revenue recognition differs.
DeItaone is the relevant quoted news account, not an OpenAI official account or Reuters reporter.
review_note: Reuters source-based reporting remains qualified; financing is proposed, IPO timing expected, revenue target prospective. The screenshot is review evidence only and will not be attached to the post.
